text:
paul.marketing: Heads-up — benchmark blog + supporting assets go live in ~25 minutes. Embargo lifts at 09:30 PT. Please stand by for on-the-record quote handoff and final reporter list.

olivia.pr: Thanks — confirm spokespeople? I have CEO + Head of Research listed. Any product ops to add?

paul.marketing: CEO + Head of Research only for embargoed quotes. Product ops should be available for technical follow-ups but off-record.

samir.engineering: Quote from Head of Research is final — small wording tweak requested earlier, updated doc has the exact wording. Putting it here: "We focused on real-world latency targets and cost per token — results align with our production goals."

olivia.pr: Perfect. Can you paste the final one-line CEO quote? I need it for the media kit.

samir.engineering: CEO draft in the doc: "Our goal is making high-performance inference predictable and economical for every engineering team." Approved by CEO.

emily.docs: I uploaded the publish checklist + media kit to the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/bench-media-kit — includes embargo list, Qs & As, and screenshots.

paul.marketing: Legal already cleared the quote and the embargo list. Final reporter list attached in the doc above. @pressbot will ping reporters when we lift.

pressbot: [automated] Scheduled outbound: embargoed emails to 24 reporters will be sent at 09:30 PT.

jordan.support: Support on standby — I'll have a focused triage channel open and a short FAQ for customers ready to publish within 10 minutes of lift. Any special issues to call out?

paul.marketing: Good — main things: 1) link to hosted API benchmark page 2) FAQ bullet about dedicated capacity SLAs 3) contact for customer escalations. Keep responses brief, route press technical questions to eng contacts.

olivia.pr: Social copy drafts are in the doc. Please thumbs-up the variant you prefer: short (CEO quote + link) or long (lead + technical bullet + link).

samir.engineering: Short variant looks good to me. :+1:

emily.docs: I've pinned the tweet text and the blog canonical URL in the kit. Also included image assets sized for LinkedIn/Medium.

paul.marketing: Ok — last check. If no blockers, we lift embargo at 09:30 PT. I will post "We're live" here and trigger the pressbot.

olivia.pr: No blockers from PR side. Team ready.

jordan.support: Team ready. Triage channel: #support-bench-live.

samir.engineering: Eng on standby for follow-ups in #eng-ml.

paul.marketing: Going live in 1 minute. Everyone stand by.

pressbot: [automated] Sending embargo lift notifications in 60 seconds.

paul.marketing: We're live — blog published: https://blog.redwood.ai/2026/benchmark-latency-cost-readout — press emails sent. Please monitor channels for incoming requests and route to the assigned owners.

olivia.pr: Noting first outreach from TechDaily. I'll handle.

samir.engineering: First technical question already in #eng-ml — checking.

jordan.support: Support reported a small spike in site traffic, nothing degraded. Will update if anything changes.

emily.docs: Putting post-publish checklist items into the doc (metrics capture, playbook debrief).

paul.marketing: Thanks everyone. Quick retrospective call at 3pm PT today to capture learnings and follow-ups (links to update requests, additional quotes).

olivia.pr: Added to calendar.

samir.engineering: I'll join.

pressbot: [automated] Thread closed for scheduling. Report: 24 emails sent, 6 opens in first 5 minutes.
